title: Wonder Of The Worlds
description: Theres A big world everywhere we go, and this Modpack shows it more than anything.
body:
# There's Something For Everyone

There's people wich like to explore the nether, others the end, other the overworld and so on, this modpack overhauls ALL of them meaning that theres something to explore for everyone



**NOTE:When creating a new world if you only care about aestethics of the world and not the dungeons/structures choose in the world format: Big Globe.**
